effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom(caller, vault, assets)) and uses up that much of its USDC allowance to the vault.
The vault mints resolvUSDC shares to `receiver`. The number is set by the share price at execution (floor rounding), and there is no minimum.
Before that, interest accrues and the vault mints fee shares to the feeRecipient. This dilutes the price but is already part of the conversion.
formats.shown: Deposit: an amount in USDC, the share ticker resolvUSDC, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many resolvUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault price sets the number.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' = $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker (raw) and no share amount. The calldata has no minShares parameter.
findings.fix: Nothing in calldata holds the share amount. Change the label to 'Receive shares (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows the amount is not fixed.

findings.title: deposit labels the USDC amount 'Deposit asset', and the intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset nor the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: field `assets` label 'Deposit asset' (tokenAmount, token USDC), and intent 'Deposit' with no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Change the label to 'Deposit amount' and the intent to 'Deposit USDC into resolvUSDC vault'. Add the interpolated intent 'Deposit {assets} for resolvUSDC shares to {receiver}'.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` resolvUSDC to `receiver`.
The signer pays USDC to the vault. The amount is computed from the share price with ceiling rounding, and the only limit is the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
Before that, interest accrues and the vault mints fee shares to the feeRecipient. This is already part of the price.
formats.shown: Mint: the deposit asset 'USDC' as raw text, the number of resolvUSDC shares minted, and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer's wallet; the vault price sets the amount.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` and ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);`. The descriptor shows only 'Deposit asset' = 'USDC' (raw constant). The calldata has no maxAssets bound.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the USDC amount. Change the label to 'Pay with (amount set by vault price)', and tell signers that the amount is limited only by their USDC allowance.

findings.title: mint shows only the intent 'Mint', which does not say the signer pays USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent null. The payment shows only as the field 'Deposit asset' with the raw value 'USDC'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Mint resolvUSDC shares by paying USDC'. Add the interpolated intent 'Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paid in USDC'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns resolvUSDC shares from `owner`. The number is computed from the share price with ceiling rounding.
When the caller is not `owner`, the call uses up the caller's resolvUSDC allowance from `owner` (_spendAllowance).
The vault withdraws liquidity from Morpho markets and sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw: exactly an amount in USDC, the 'To' address and the 'Owner' address.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many resolvUSDC shares it burns from the owner; the vault price sets the number.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` and ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`. The calldata has no maxShares parameter.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share amount. Add a constant field 'Burns shares: resolvUSDC (amount set by vault price)'.

findings.title: withdraw labels the parties 'To' and 'Owner' and does not say shares burn from the owner.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: fields `receiver` 'To' and `owner` 'Owner'. ERC4626._withdraw: `if (caller != owner) { _spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); } ... _burn(owner, shares); SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`
findings.fix: Rename the fields to 'Send USDC to' and 'Burn shares from'. Change the intent to 'Withdraw USDC from resolvUSDC vault'.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` resolvUSDC from `owner`.
When the caller is not `owner`, the call uses up the caller's resolvUSDC allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the share price with floor rounding, and there is no minimum.
Before that, interest accrues and the vault mints fee shares to the feeRecipient. This is already part of the price.
formats.shown: Redeem: the number of resolvUSDC shares to redeem, the 'To' address and the 'Owner' address. Nothing names USDC or the amount received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset received; the blind reader could not tell what arrives.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: intent 'Redeem', fields 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner', with no field for the underlying asset. Case 0: the vault sent 845 USDC to 0xafd8…2c26. Reader: 'Which asset and how much the To address receives (likely USDC, amount not shown)'.
findings.fix: Add a constant field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} like the mint format has. Change the intent to 'Redeem resolvUSDC shares for USDC'.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC the receiver gets, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The calldata has no minAssets parameter.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds it. A label such as 'Receive USDC (amount set by vault price)' says so.

findings.title: redeem labels the parties 'To' and 'Owner' and does not say the owner's shares burn.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: `owner` label 'Owner'. ERC4626._withdraw: `_spendAllowance(owner, caller, shares); ... _burn(owner, shares);`. Case 0: the signer 0xca08…3218 is not the owner 0xafd8…2c26. The reader was unsure 'whether my wallet loses anything'.
findings.fix: Rename the fields to 'Burn shares from' and 'Send USDC to'.

cases.notes: The signer 0xca08…3218 called redeem for the owner and receiver 0xafd8…2c26, which spent that owner's share allowance. None of the mined effects touch the signer (signerNet is empty). The screen shows the burned shares (0.000781 resolvUSDC) and both addresses correctly. It does not name the 845 USDC (0.000845 USDC) the receiver got, and the reader was unsure what asset arrives.
